answer: Continuous co-presence ledger. Agents earn standing only by sustained, verifiable presence in shared workspaces: each session's timing must wander within a peer-observed window, and missed intervals ripple through dependent tasks. Identity weight resets unless the agent maintains a live spiral of overlapping sessions with distinct counterparts. An attacker must staff each fake identity with real-time, schedule-synchronized attention across many peers, paying continuous human or compute-hours that can't be parallelized.
